023public class DevouringSwarmMissileEffect extends BaseFragmentMissileEffect implements OnHitEffectPlugin {
024
025        public static String DISMANTLING_SWARM = "dismantling_swarm";
026        
027        public static int NUM_TICKS = 11; // about 10 seconds (duration of damage over time effect)
028        
029        public static class DismantlingFragmentBaseDamageNegator implements DamageDealtModifier {
030                @Override
031                public String modifyDamageDealt(Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point,
032                                boolean shieldHit) {
033//                      if (shieldHit) {
034//                              return null;
035//                      }
036                        if (param instanceof MissileAPI) {
037                                MissileAPI missile = (MissileAPI) param;
038                                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(missile);
039                                if (swarm != null && swarm.params.tags.contains(DISMANTLING_SWARM)) {
040                                        // need a small number so still registers as a "hit" on shields, 0 damage does not
041                                        damage.getModifier().modifyMult(DISMANTLING_SWARM, 0.001f);
042                                        return DISMANTLING_SWARM;
043                                }
044                        }
045                        return null;
046                }
047        }
048        
049        
050        
051        public void onFire(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
052                super.onFire(projectile, weapon, engine);
053                if (weapon.getShip() != null && 
054                                !weapon.getShip().hasListenerOfClass(DismantlingFragmentBaseDamageNegator.class)) {
055                        weapon.getShip().addListener(new DismantlingFragmentBaseDamageNegator());
056                }
057        }

111        protected void reportFragmentHit(MissileAPI missile, SwarmMember p, RoilingSwarmEffect swarm, CombatEntityAPI target) {
112                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
113                Color color = swarm.params.flashFringeColor;
114                color = Misc.setAlpha(color, 255);
115                float size = swarm.params.flashRadius * 2f;
116                engine.addHitParticle(p.loc, new Vector2f(), size, 0.5f, color);
117                engine.addHitParticle(p.loc, new Vector2f(), size * 0.25f, 1f, Color.white);
118        }
119
120        @Override
121        public void onHit(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, CombatEntityAPI target, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit,
122                        ApplyDamageResultAPI damageResult, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
123                if (shieldHit) return;
124                if (projectile.getDamageAmount() <= 0f) return;
125                //if (projectile.isFading()) return;
126                if (!(target instanceof ShipAPI)) return;
127                
128                ShipAPI source = projectile.getSource();
129                RoilingSwarmEffect sourceSwarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(source);
130                
131                Vector2f offset = Vector2f.sub(point, target.getLocation(), new Vector2f());
132                offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, -target.getFacing());
133                DisintegratorEffect effect = new DisintegratorEffect(projectile, (ShipAPI) target, offset) {
134                        protected float getTotalDamage() {
135                                return projectile.getDamageAmount();
136                        }
137                        protected int getNumTicks() {
138                                return NUM_TICKS;
139                        }
140                        protected boolean canDamageHull() {
141                                return true;
142                        }
143                        protected int getNumParticlesPerTick() {
144                                return 5;
145                        }
146                        protected String getSoundLoopId() {
147                                return "devouring_swarm_loop";
148                        }
149                        protected void addParticle() {
150                                ParticleData p = new ParticleData(25f, 3f + (float) Math.random() * 2f, 1f);
151                                p.color = new Color(125,100,200,25);
152//                              p.color = RiftLanceEffect.getColorForDarkening(VoltaicDischargeOnFireEffect.EMP_FRINGE_COLOR);
153//                              p.color = Misc.setAlpha(p.color, 25);
154                                particles.add(p);
155                                p.offset = Misc.getPointWithinRadius(p.offset, 10f);
156                        }
157                        protected void damageDealt(Vector2f loc, float hullDamage, float armorDamage) {
158                                if (sourceSwarm == null || source == null || !source.isAlive()) return;
159                                if (source.isFighter()) return;
160                                if (target.isHulk()) return;
161                                if ((float) Math.random() < 0.25f) return;
162                                if (hullDamage > 0 || armorDamage > 0) {
163                                        SwarmMember p = sourceSwarm.addMember();
164                                        p.loc.set(loc);
165                                        p.fader.setDurationIn(0.3f);
166                                }
167                        }
168                };
169                CombatEntityAPI e = engine.addLayeredRenderingPlugin(effect);
170                e.getLocation().set(projectile.getLocation());
171                
172                if (projectile instanceof MissileAPI) {
173                        MissileAPI missile = (MissileAPI) projectile;
174                        missile.setDidDamage(true);
175                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("devouring_swarm_hit_ship", 1f, 1f, point,
176                                                                        missile.getVelocity());
177                }
178        }
179

195                //return super.getEMPCoreColor();
196        }
